abstract: Four children with yolk sac tumor were treated with an aggressive combination chemotherapy program. Three children had presacral primary tumors, one having pulmonary metastases, and one had a testicular primary tumor with pulmonary metastases. Three children were treated when they had measurable disease, and one had no measurable disease. The chemotherapy program consisted of a 6-wk induction period with vincristine (VCR), cis-diamminedichloroplatinum (DDP), and bleomycin. Maintenance therapy consisted of VCR, actinomycin D, and cyclophosphamide (cytoxan) every 3-4 wk as tolerated. Treatment was discontinued after 12 mo of complete remission. All three patients with evaluable disease had a partial response (PR) to induction therapy. Two underwent surgical exploration following induction therapy, one a laparotomy and the other a thoracotomy, and were found to have only scar tissue at the sites of presumed residual disease. The third child with measurable disease progressed to a clinical complete response (CR) during maintenance therapy. Two patients have had no evidence of disease (NED) for 42+ and 41+ mo since starting therapy (28+ and 27+ mo since completing treatment). Two patients are NED 11+ and 7+ mo since starting therapy and remain on treatment. We have encountered no significant renal or pulmonary toxicity, and there have been only two hospitalizations during maintenance therapy for fever and neutropenia. These preliminary results employing different induction and maintenance chemotherapy programs and planned second-look surgical intervention appear encouraging.
abstract_ja: 進行卵黄嚢腫瘍の小児4例に対し、積極的な併用化学療法を施行した。治療は6週間の導入期間に、ビンクリスチン(VCR)、シスプラチン(DDP)、ブレオマイシンを用いた。その後の維持療法は、3～4週ごとに耐容性に応じてVCR、アクチノマイシンD、シクロホスファミドを投与した。治療は完全寛解の12か月後に中止した。評価可能な病変を有する3例はすべて導入療法で部分奏効(PR)を示した。導入療法後に2例は開腹術または開胸術による再評価を受け、推定残存病変の部位は瘢痕組織のみであった。測定可能な病変を有していた3例目は、維持療法中に臨床的完全奏効(CR)に進行した。2例は治療開始後42+か月および41+か月、治療終了後28+か月および27+か月の時点で無病(NED)である。治療開始後11+か月および7+か月のNED例が2例あり、現在も治療中である。維持療法中に有意な腎毒性や肺毒性は認めず、発熱と好中球減少による入院は2回のみであった。異なる導入・維持化学療法プログラムと計画的な二次的開腹手術による本予備的結果は有望と考えられる。
